resources.string: Reads the screen aloud with customisable gestures, low-latency background event handling and a plugin system based on scripts.
This element has no identifier, so it can\'t be labelled
OCR uses ML Kit\'s Latin-script recogniser: it reads Latin text well, but accents may be wrong with small or blurry text, and other scripts (Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic) are not recognised.
\"Describe image\" only lists recognised objects (about 400 kinds, in English, translated where possible) and does not write full sentences.
Only buttons with an internal identifier can be labelled. At most %1$d labels.
Multi-finger gestures need touch exploration (already on). If the phone doesn\'t recognise them, try again placing all fingers at the same time.
